in_marathi.name: Lakshmikar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakshmikar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. Lakshmikar is a name revered in Hindu culture for those seeking wealth, fortune, and success.
